subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Beauty and the Beast
description: A quick win: understand Beauty and the Beast.

hook.text: A woman learns to love a monster. When she does, he transforms. The oldest version is from 1740.

buildup.text: The Beast represents the Shadow: ugly, feared, imprisoned in a dark castle. Beauty sees past the surface.

discovery.text: Love transforms the Beast because acceptance integrates the Shadow. What you embrace changes form.

twist.text: Some scholars see patriarchal control: a woman taught to love her captor. The reading cuts both ways.

climax.text: The tale endures because both readings are true. Myths hold contradictions without resolving them.

punchline.text: Love the ugly truth. Watch it transform.

quiz.question: What happens when Beauty accepts the Beast?
